title: Cross-session institutional memory without conversational-memory dependence
summary: Relevant security findings survive session boundaries in SecurityEvidenceStore. Shannon or another channel receives the current capability/security envelope; the restriction does not depend on the conversational model remembering an earlier transcript.
invariants: New sessions do not start epistemically from zero when durable relevant evidence exists.
Shannon memory is not the security mechanism.
Unverified third-party reports remain unverified while still being relevant to specific actions.
Unrelated low-risk customer-service abilities can remain available.

provenance.claim: The Barbie cross-session scenario and SecurityEvidenceStore semantics preserve relevant findings without converting allegations to truth.
